query:
SELECT 
  mes,
  ano,
  empresaSlug,
  COUNT(DISTINCT clienteId) as clientes_unicos,
  COUNT(*) as total_registros
FROM cashbarberAtendimentos
WHERE mes IN (3, 4, 5) AND ano = 2026
GROUP BY mes, ano, empresaSlug
ORDER BY mes, empresaSlug;
